url.description: The public https page to capture (product, reviews, pricing, press article, demo).

outputs.description: screenshot = a PNG still; recording = an MP4 scroll-through. Default both.

full_page.description: Screenshot the whole page instead of one screen (capped at 16,000 px tall).

duration_sec.description: Recording length in seconds (2-15, default 8, 30 fps).

highlight_selector.description: CSS selector of one element to outline; the capture scrolls to it.

highlight_text.description: Visible text to outline instead of a selector (e.g. "4.9 stars").

locale.description: Browser language, e.g. es-CL, so a localized site serves that language. Default en-US.
